semantics: ScalarReductionFission.cpp starts a participant counter at zero, increments once on the common update arm and merges unchanged/advanced counts at the unique latch. Before iteration i, 0<=count<=i; each store indexes count<N<=M and final P<=N fits the checked IV/capacity. The guard has only the latch as predecessor. Its original count PHI is exactly [merge,latch], so merge and count both denote P on all consumer invocations. Single-LV SCEV expansion uses merge as AVL seed. The immutable t000010 failure dump shows repeated LV instead using fission.participating.merge.lcssa. At exact base revision 5eba181f460dad516650c558c550e984b6b4b914, LoopVectorizePass::runImpl forms LCSSA recursively before processLoop. LCSSA.cpp inserts I.name+.lcssa at the start of a dominated exit, adds I for every real predecessor and rewrites outside-loop uses; PHI uses are located on incoming edges. Therefore count retains [merge,latch] while the AVL use on vector.ph is rewritten through a new guard PHI: fission.participating.merge.lcssa = phi i64 [merge,latch]. The latch dominates the guard, the only entry to consumer.ph and then vector.ph, so forwarded P dominates the AVL incoming edge. This definition is source-derived, not observed in a recovered full repeated-LV dump; that missing artifact is requested below. The same immutable LCSSA algorithm forwards ordered double/float results through middle.block PHIs [actual reduction result,vector.body] and rewrites their nonempty result-join operands. Integer scalar reductions are computed in middle.block, outside the vector loop, and remain direct. Separate ONCE/REPEAT FileCheck prefixes capture these exact relationships before connecting them to AVL and result PHIs. Common checks retain all three VP loads and both ordered FP reductions using one EVL, AVL-=EVL until zero, both integer results and every unchanged empty-stream start. The checker accepts only merge, its original count export and the exact demonstrated guard merge.lcssa PHI after checking recurrence, inputs and real single-entry branches. FP results may be direct or pass through exactly one middle.block PHI from the actual reduction on vector.body. No recursive equivalence analysis is added. Scalar-remainder minimum-iteration, rounding, vector completion, tail bypass, termination, active-length, result-start and branch checks remain. Original branches/operations, participant order, add flags/operand order, P=0 starts without arithmetic or scratch loads, inactive operands, alias behavior, masks/tails/live-outs and nested scratch reuse remain under the previous transformation contract. Strictfp/constrained FP and unsafe effects/calls remain rejected; both fission FP-option settings retain ordered behavior on this early path. Actual transformed producer/vector/tail execution must be compared to original scalar references with exact N/P/vector/tail probes. Parser fixtures supplement DOM/LI/SE verification and executable comparisons; they are not semantic execution tests.
costs: Let M be the proven maximum original trip count, P the participating count, and S the sum of allocation sizes of distinct contribution SSA values. Scratch capacity remains M*S plus existing ABI alignment padding, checked with unsigned overflow/index bounds and the existing 65536-byte default per-candidate ceiling. It does not shrink with P, is allocated statically in function entry, and can occupy frame space even on guarded bypass. Logical scratch traffic is P*S stores plus P*S loads, with no per-iteration mask/index arrays. The two mixed fixtures have four accumulators but one 65*i32, one 65*double and one 65*float array: 1044 accounted bytes including 4 padding bytes, and 32*P traffic bytes. The two i64 sums share one slot: 520 bytes and 16*P traffic. Nested i32/double uses 784 accounted bytes including 4 padding bytes, reused each row, and 24*sum(P_row) logical traffic; capacity does not multiply by Rows. Default-limit tests admit 16384 i32 slots (65536 bytes) and reject 16385 (65540); i8 capacity 255 is representable while 256 original trips are rejected. Real frame padding/cache traffic are not measured. Original input loads/helper calls execute once on their original branches, with zero new original-input rereads, contribution recomputation or duplicated producer operations. Counter overhead is one carried index PHI and latch merge per original iteration plus one nuw increment per participant, using existing producer control with no new per-iteration branch. Added consumer control runs P iterations, plus one zero-count guard per producer completion, a consumer preheader, dedicated loop exit and initial/result join. Normal LV may add its own independent vector/tail guards. There are no new alias/SCEV guards, full-trip masks, dynamic/unbounded allocations, general compaction machinery or profitability model. Analysis is linear in instructions/uses plus fixed CFG checks and existing SCEV analysis; emission uses distinct-contribution/export maps and the existing full-function dominator recalculation. Host-only probes perturb the test executable and are excluded from RVV codegen inputs. This repair changes no compiler emission or runtime costs. It adds only a bounded fixture-specific provenance check over printed SSA definitions, entry branches and control/result operands, plus parser fixtures; there is no recursive equivalence solver, new guard, scratch allocation, reread, duplication, recomputation, storage machinery or profitability model.
